blocks.text: Communications leader and educator Angel G. Lopez unveiled BECOMING HER, a memoir that pairs heartfelt storytelling with original digital paintings to trace the life she has had to rebuild since losing her husband who was the love of her life, her best friend and the man she had imagined growing old with. “We spend much of our lives becoming who we want to be,” Lopez said. “But sometimes life makes that decision for us.” Launched at Flour Pot & Bakery in Bonifacio Global City, the book is an intimate account of love, bereavement, motherhood, and faith.
